name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, MAY 24, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Member of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89947845819
  Webinar ID: 899 4784 5819
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16699009128,,89947845819# OR +16694449171,,89947845819#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 US or +1 669 444 9171 or +1 253 215 8782

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro
  Tem Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of May 10, 2023 Study Session and May 10, 2023 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. City School Program - White Oak Elementary School 4th Grade Students

  2. Presentation of a City of Westlake Village Kindness Award to Cecilia DePippo,
  White Oak Elementary School Office Manager

RECESS

Recess for White Oak Elementary Students departure

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1
of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to
the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Chamber of Commerce Report

4.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING: CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 02-005 MODIFICATION
  NO. 7; RESOLUTION NO. 2299-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2299-23, determining
  Conditional Use Permit No. 02-005 is exempt from CEQA and approving
  Modification No. 7 to authorize the continued sale of alcohol for onsite and offsite
  consumption within a commercial suite of a business park located at 30961 Agoura
  Road, Suite 321.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2299-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING AN EXTENSION OF THE PERMIT TERM FOR CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT NO. 02-005 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED SALE OF ALCOHOL FOR ONSITE
  AND OFFSITE CONSUMPTION WITHIN AN EXISTING BUSINESS PARK LOCATED AT 30961
  AGOURA ROAD, SUITE NO. 321

2.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-001; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2300-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2300-23, determining Conditional Use Permit
  No. 23-001 is exempt from CEQA and approving Conditional Use Permit No. 23-001
  to reauthorize an existing wireless telecommunications facility located at 32129
  Lindero Canyon Road.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2300-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-001, RELATIVE TO THE
  OPERATION OF A ROOFTOP WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITY AT 32129
  LINDERO CANYON ROAD

3.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-004;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2301-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2301-23, determining Planned
  Development Permit No. 22-004 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing an interior
  and exterior remodel and the construction of a new 1,062 sq. ft. addition of habitable
  space to an existing single-family residence located at 4040 Whitesail Circle.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2301-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-004,
  AUTHORIZING THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW 1,062 SQ. FT. ADDITION OF HABITABLE
  SPACE AND AN INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR REMODEL OF AN EXISTING 2,432 SQ. FT. TWO-
  STORY SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE LOCATED AT 4040 WHITESAIL CIRCLE

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective May 15, 2023 in the amount of
  $1,327,886.05
  GENERAL BUSINESS:
  1.  APPROVAL OF RENEWAL RATE ADJUSTMENTS FOR THE DELTA
  DENTAL PLAN AND AMENDMENTS TO THE VISION AND DISABILITY
  BENEFIT PLANS; RESOLUTION 2302-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2302-23
  approving the renewal rate adjustments for the dental plan and amendments
  to the vision and disability benefit plans, effective July 1, 2023.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2302-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING THE RENEWAL RATE ADJUSTMENTS FOR DENTAL
  PLAN AND AMENDMENTS TO THE VISION AND DISABILITY BENEFIT PLANS
  EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2023

  2.  AUTHORIZATION FOR ACCESS TO CRIMINAL BACKGROUND
  INFORMATION AND SUBMITTAL OF THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT
  OF JUSTICE APPLICATION FOR ACCESS TO CRIMINAL BACKGROUND
  INFORMATION; RESOLUTION 2303-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2303-23
  authorizing use of State, Federal and local summary criminal history
  information and the City’s submission of an application to obtain State,
  Federal and local level summary criminal history information pursuant to
  Penal Code sections 11105(b)(11) and 13300(b)(11) for employment related
  purposes.
  RESOLUTION NO. 2303-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE AUTHORIZING ACCESS TO CRIMINAL HISTORY INFORMATION
  FOR EMPLOYMENT PURPOSES AND SUBMISSION OF AN APPLICATION FOR SUCH
  ACCESS TO THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE

  3.  ACCEPTANCE OF THE NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE SHADE
  STRUCTURE REPLACEMENT AT BERNIECE BENNETT PARK - Accept
  the Shade Structure Replacement at Berniece Bennett Park Project and
  authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a Notice of Completion on
  behalf of the City.

  4.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 302-23. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE REGARDING
  SMALL UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS, AMENDING THE WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING CHAPTER 4.12 AND APPROVING
  A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION – Waive the second reading and
  adopt Ordinance No. 302-23.
  ORDINANCE NO. 302-23 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  REGARDING SMALL UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS, AMENDING THE WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE ADDING CHAPTER 4.12 AND APPROVING A CEQA
  EXEMPTION DETERMINATION
 OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, May 18, 2023 at 4:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.
